factor_name: 10-Day Momentum Normalized by 20-Day Absolute Return Path

calculation.description: Ranks assets by their trailing 10-day return scaled by the recent typical absolute daily movement, using only completed observations. Higher values indicate stronger momentum relative to recent path volatility.

validation.regime_notes: 10-day signal passed the benchmark absolute IC and ICIR gates, but coverage is limited by the path-volatility denominator and available histories. Predictive sign was negative in 2026, 2029, and 2030 and positive in 2027, 2028, and 2031 YTD; uncertainty is material with a 15-instrument cross-section. Predictive power reverses by 20 days, so use only at short horizons.
